purpose: 선택 욕구가 정답이나 운명 예고가 아니라 표정·손끝·몸이 먼저 향한 단서와 두려움이 함께 보이는 close-emotion 12개 편집 검토안이다. 2026-09-05 사용자 승인에 따라 한국어 해석·질문·제목·그림 설명의 교정본을 반영했다. 원화와 최초 제작·시각 승인 이력은 유지한다.

renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-desire close-emotion guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair; no extra guardian, adviser, family member, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve canonical identity, colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or pair plus one immediate choice control covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Frame face, hand, pincer, fin or first body cue closely so desire and fear coexist; never declare a correct choice, destiny, guaranteed peace, status or future outcome. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Doors, pads, seals, handles, tokens and bays remain ajar, removable, unnamed, unchosen or open-ended. Libra may use exactly one abstract choice balance; no other sign uses a scale. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, paper grain, plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
